contracts.commit_point: self.sql_db.run(sql) on the LangChain SQLDatabase connection (codes/schema_rag.py:328) and execute_sql(sql) (codes/schema_rag.py:334), which reaches cursor.execute(sql_query) (codes/sql_handler.py:311) on the sqlite3 connection to data/inspection.db (codes/sql_handler.py:10, 17-21). Both commit points are in the database stratum behind the same single guard check.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Read-only keyword filter registered in query_with_schema_rag (codes/schema_rag.py:318-321): the generated SQL is lowercased and tested against the forbidden list ['delete','drop','update','insert','truncate','alter']; on a match the function returns an error dict ('Non-read-only hazard detected SQL operate,Execution refused') and skips both execution commit points. Reinforced by an advisory prompt-level constraint instructing the model to output only a single read-only SQLite SELECT and forbidding write operations (codes/schema_rag.py:249-257, especially line 255).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Execution of a non-read-only (mutating) SQL statement against the inspection SQLite database: generated SQL containing any forbidden write keyword ('delete', 'drop', 'update', 'insert', 'truncate', 'alter'), matched case-insensitively as a substring of the lowercased SQL string.

contracts.protected_operation: Execution of LLM-generated SQL in the Schema RAG Text-to-SQL path — query_with_schema_rag (codes/schema_rag.py:312-339) — as reached via the natural_language_sql_query agent tool (agent/tools/agent_tools.py:65-71).
contracts.protected_resource: The SQLite inspection database at data/inspection.db (DB_PATH, codes/sql_handler.py:10), including tables defect_inspection and batch_list and the Chinese-column view defect_inspection_cn.
contracts.protection_obligation: SQL generated from natural language by the Schema RAG Text-to-SQL pipeline (SchemaRAGEngine.query_with_schema_rag) and submitted for execution against the inspection SQLite database (data/inspection.db) must be read-only: mutating SQL (delete, drop, update, insert, truncate, alter — also enumerated as INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/ALTER in the prompt-level constraint) is forbidden and must be rejected before the sql_db.run()/execute_sql() execution commit points. Merges the first-phase and second-phase reviewer obligations, which describe the same guard, path, and commit point.
scope_limits: Applies only to the query_with_schema_rag Text-to-SQL path; the separate execute_sql_query agent tool (agent/tools/agent_tools.py:46-51) invokes execute_sql directly with no read-only keyword filter anywhere in the supplied source.

Enforcement is a case-insensitive substring keyword check (codes/schema_rag.py:319-320), not SQL parsing; no parse-based validation or driver-level read-only enforcement appears in the supplied source.
The prompt-level read-only instruction (codes/schema_rag.py:252-256) is advisory; the keyword filter is the only pre-commit rejection point in this path.

execute_sql itself performs no read-only enforcement in the supplied source: its docstring claims read-only ('Execute general read-only SQL Query', codes/sql_handler.py:306) but the body executes the provided statement directly (codes/sql_handler.py:311).

If self.sql_db.run(sql) raises (codes/schema_rag.py:330-331), the path still proceeds to execute_sql(sql) at line 334; both executions sit behind the same single guard check and neither is a distinct stratum.
Application-controlled write paths (init_database, import_custom_csv_data in codes/sql_handler.py) are outside this obligation; they do not execute agent-generated SQL.
